what: Default TSV path needs parent dirs but tally only mkdir-p DESIGN_TMPDIR
scenario_or_breakage: Direct tally or test-tally-plan-review without plan-review-loop mkdir-p fails writing plan-review/round-1/findings-classification.tsv
suggested_fix: Require mkdir -p dirname of final TSV inside tally-plan-review.sh (not only plan-review-loop.sh)

what: voting_result wording says main-agent-required while classify_result(eligible=0) emits rejected
scenario_or_breakage: Implementor may write literal main-agent-required into TSV or skip classify_result producing schema drift vs multi-judge rows
suggested_fix: State explicitly use classify_result 0 0 0 0 yielding rejected as the voting_result cell for zero-judge rows

what: Axis fields copied into TSV are not sanitized beyond reviewer_slots
scenario_or_breakage: Judge emits tab or newline inside an axis token columns shift or rows split corrupting analytics
suggested_fix: Strip or replace tabs and newlines in each parsed axis value before TSV write same as reviewer_slots rule

what: Block iteration uses shell glob order for ballot blocks
scenario_or_breakage: TSV row order varies by filesystem locale breaking stable diffs across CI hosts
suggested_fix: Sort block ids (FINDING then OOS numeric) before emitting classification rows

what: New plan-review staging omits symlink rejection present for render-cache
scenario_or_breakage: Attacker or tooling replaces plan-review with symlink could widen staging surface
suggested_fix: Mirror render-cache checks reject symlinks for DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review before enumerating

what: Last matching duplicate ID line wins but parser contract silent
scenario_or_breakage: If judge emits two lines for same id vote and ratings can disagree on which line is authoritative
suggested_fix: Document last-wins in parse-judge-vote-and-rating.md and assert in harness fixtures

what: Code retry prefix names only FINDING_N while code ballots stay finding-only today
scenario_or_breakage: Future code ballot grammar adding OOS ids would leave retry text misaligned with renderer
